purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt (shinryo-koui) system – contraindicated drug combination check and editing for outpatient/inpatient treatment acts
purpose.summary: This subprogram (ORCSCKNKCHK) performs contraindicated drug (kinki-yakuzai) checking and editing for the ORCA medical receipt system. It validates drug combinations against interaction master tables (tbl_interact) and check masters (tbl_chk), building SPA parameter areas for downstream processing. It handles both outpatient and inpatient cases and supports group diagnosis processing.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with multiple SPA (screen parameter area) parameters
OCCURS tables for drug combination check (up to 100 and 30 entries)
Database access via MCP layer (MCPDATA-REC, MCP-TABLE, MCP-PATHNAME)
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese, appearing garbled. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 58717 bytes (1346 lines total). Program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. GnuCOBOL dialect inferred from ORCA project conventions.
